_about: The three service lines. The hero routing diagram and the service-line rows both read this list. Copy is verbatim from Source/kaltech-services.html.

lines.title: AI and software consulting
lines.intro: We establish what should be built and what should not. This covers the diagnostic, architecture decisions, build-versus-buy calls, and the sequencing of a roadmap against payback rather than ambition. It ends in a written finding and a scope, not a deck.

subs.head: What brings people here
subs.body: A build has been proposed internally or quoted by a vendor, and nobody in the room can say with confidence whether it addresses the thing that is actually costing money.

subs.head: What an engagement looks like
subs.body: Two to three weeks, senior-led throughout, ending in a written finding and a priced scope.

subs.head: What it is not
subs.body: A strategy deck, a vendor comparison exercise, or a discovery phase staffed by people who will not build the work.

lines.title: AI and software development
lines.intro: We build and ship production systems. Platforms, internal tooling, integrations, and applied AI where it earns its place. Senior engineers on the work throughout, with no junior tier absorbing the delivery.

subs.head: What brings people here
subs.body: The constraint is established and the case is settled, and what is needed now is a system that survives production rather than a prototype that survives a demo.

subs.head: What an engagement looks like
subs.body: Scoped against a diagnostic finding and delivered in stages, with the existing operation live throughout and a working system in production before the final stage.

subs.head: What it is not
subs.body: Staff augmentation, offshore capacity, or a prototype delivered with an invoice for the learning.

lines.title: Technology strategy and transformation
lines.intro: We work alongside operators through a change that spans more than one system. Migration off legacy platforms, consolidation of fragmented data, and the operating decisions that come with both.

subs.head: What brings people here
subs.body: A change is already underway, it touches more than one system, and the decisions are arriving faster than a fixed scope can absorb them.

subs.head: What an engagement looks like
subs.body: A retainer, because the work outlasts a single build. Reviewed at agreed intervals against what it has moved, rather than renewed by default.

subs.head: What it is not
subs.body: An ongoing support contract, a managed service, or a seat on a steering committee.

steps.title: Diagnostic
steps.body: Two to three weeks against the three lenses, ending in a written finding.

steps.title: Scope
steps.body: Priced against the finding, sequenced by payback rather than ambition.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Senior-led delivery, staged, with the existing operation live throughout.

steps.title: Retainer
steps.body: Where the work outlasts the build, we stay on the roadmap.
